messages:
emma: Quick heads-up — Customer (Greenfield Analytics) sent back an MSA with two redlines and asked for a signed commitment letter + PO before the POC starts. They also want KMS key material in the DPA and EFT/net30. Can legal/finance advise?

jordan: Thanks. The POC itself is small (1 GPU, 2 concurrent sessions) — we can start without KMS if they accept a SOC2-level handling, but if they need customer-managed keys we have to route to Private or Dedicated.

emma: They explicitly said they don't want to run on our shared hosted tier if KMS isn't present. So looks like either Dedicated or Private. Asking for pricing delta & timeline.

natalie: Can you drop the customer's redline PDF here? I'll scan for signature blocks and the specific KMS language. If it's just "customer-managed keys", we can offer a bring-your-keys addendum for Private. If they're asking for HSM-level key escrow, that's a larger SOW.

emma: Uploaded their redline: `GREENFIELD_MSA_redline_v3.pdf` (link pasted) — main asks: 1) KMS control clause in DPA 2) Commitment letter stating start date tied to PO receipt 3) Exec signature on order form, PO to reference SOW, and invoice to be sent to their AP email.

samir: From finance: net30 is fine. EFT preferred. We need vendor setup (W-9) and the PO number on invoices. For Dedicated there's a 30–45 day provisioning lead time after signature. Pricing delta for Dedicated vs Hosted: add 30% on top of hosted list. If they want Private on-prem, that's a different procurement track.

jordan: Technical note: For KV cache and latency guarantees we can hit their SLA on Dedicated; for Private we'll need security onboarding (vpn, KMS integration) which is a 2–4 week engineering window post-contract.

emma: Natalie — can we push back on linking the start date to PO receipt? We'd prefer start date = signed order form countersigned by Redwood. PO can be used for billing but not gating deployment.

natalie: Agree. Proposed language: "Services will commence upon Redwood's countersignature of the Order Form; Customer may issue a PO for internal billing which will not delay the commencement of Services." I'll draft that and the commitment letter template.

claire: For the POC handoff, CS will need a single technical contact and billing contact from the customer. Also ask them if they need a mutual NDA on telemetry.

emma: Customer provided billing contact: ap@greenfield.co and legal contact: procurement@greenfield.co. They also requested a signature delegation clause allowing the VP Finance to sign POs up to $250k.

natalie: Signature authority: we can accept a PO signed by authorized officers if the PO explicitly references the executed Order Form (include contract ID). If they want to restrict signature to "VP Finance" specifically, that's risky — prefer a generic "authorized signatory" plus a notarized delegation if they insist.

samir: Practical flow for invoicing: invoice goes to ap@greenfield.co, include PO#, remit-to details (our bank). I'll create a vendor onboarding checklist: W-9, remit address, PO examples.

docu-sign-bot: docu-sign-bot: Order Form template (v1.4) uploaded — /drive/redwood/contracts/order_form_v1.4.pdf

jordan: Also note: if they require KMS key usage in the DPA, we need to attach the KMS addendum and confirm which deployment mode they'll accept. I'll prepare two modeling numbers (Dedicated vs Private) and estimated provisioning timelines.

emma: Next steps: 1) Natalie drafts counter language + commitment letter 2) Samir sends vendor onboarding checklist & sample invoice remit 3) Jordan prepares cost + timeline for Dedicated vs Private 4) I'll call procurement tomorrow at 10am PT to confirm signer and PO timing.

natalie: I'll drop the draft redline in here by EOD.

samir: I'll email the onboarding checklist to emma and cc billing ops.

claire: I'll prep the CS kickoff checklist and confirm technical contact expectations.

emma: Thanks team :thumbsup: — will post notes after the procurement call.
